data.name: Maiden's Shield
data.description: A sanguine angel is treated as if she had the Two-Weapon Fighting feat as long as she isusing a longsword and a shield. This allows her to take feats that require Two-Weapon Fighting as a prerequisite without meeting the Two-Weapon Fighting or Dexterity prerequisites, but she benefits from such feats only when she's wielding a longsword and shield.
